method: Separate isolated contexts seeded before boot. Controlled snapshots are not naturally earned progression. All movement, repair and upgrade transactions use real keyboard input; no teleport, live grants or state setters.

cases.name: purchase
cases.scope: Controlled 100-kindling, HP70, zero-growth fixture; real repair costs 1 (HP74/reserve99), first vitality upgrade costs 8 (level1/reserve91), survives reload; actor/readout exclusion.

cases.name: damaged
cases.scope: Controlled visual snapshot only: main, upper and growth panel; no claim of naturally reaching this progression.

cases.name: capped
cases.scope: Controlled visual snapshot only: main, upper and growth panel; no claim of naturally reaching this progression.
